curriculum.curriculum_summary: This 8-month, 3-hours/day (576-hour) hiring-focused curriculum reserves ~8% (46 hours) as buffer for revision/interviews and plans 530 hours of structured learning. Modules progress from foundational math and data skills through applied ML, deep learning with TensorFlow, and production practices (Docker, REST, Flask, AWS). Emphasis is on building 3 polished, end-to-end projects (classical ML, deep learning, and a deployed MLOps example) and interview readiness (coding + system design + behavioral). The stack intentionally centers on Python and TensorFlow, uses scikit-learn for classical ML, and targets AWS for cloud deployment. Time allocation prioritizes high hiring-impact areas (Deep Learning, ML fundamentals, deployment, and projects) while compressing lower-impact optional topics. Follow the module ordering (respecting prerequisites) and use the buffer for iterative improvement and mock interviews before applying to roles.
